reason: Reproduced in the real page. owner-flight at 1440, open 'Menu tasting at The Orchard' and press +7: menu goes 16 -> 23 and both it and 'Send the invitations' get style top:414px, so both .b-away counts land at page y659 and both .b-tick marks at y662/663 - one 23 and one tick painted over an identical 23 and tick, so the second moment has no visible count and no visible mark. place() pushes the follower's copy 93px (not 83) to y750, and the crowded plate it gets is box-shadow/background var(--back), which on the ink ground is the field colour, so there is no boundary at all: the crop shows one accent tick, one 23, and four lines that read as a single card with the date printed twice. Nothing states that a day now holds two. This is not a gate restatement - interaction-check.mjs asserts proportionality, the count following the move, and that the editor plate covers no row, but nothing about coincident days; audit.mjs cannot see it. It is also not 'already handled': place()'s push rule is a considered answer to NEAR pairs and the right one, but at exact equality it degrades into a duplicate over-print plus an orphan row, and multiple moments on one day is the flagship case (the day-of state exists precisely because a wedding day holds several). The seat's numbers are loose in two places (push 93px not 83px, the inter-row gap is 10px not 24px) and the counts do not 'disappear' so much as coincide, but the defect and its cause are correctly identified.
sharpenedFix: Build the grouped form WITHOUT reparenting - it can be done entirely as placement plus attributes on the nodes that already exist, so the round-1 objection does not apply to this shape. Do NOT do what the finding literally proposes (one .b-item containing rows): that destroys and recreates item nodes mid-gesture, which strands the editor closure's `item` reference (setAway, the steppers, visButton all hold it), leaves closeEditor(focusBack) focusing a detached .b-grab, and shifts the gate's per-item selectors (top/away/shown proportionality, 'every row speaks its unit' via .b-item textContent, and the delete arithmetic `.b-item count === before - 1`, which would silently drop by one whenever two share a day). Instead, in place(): group by equal data-date (exact equality only - near pairs keep today's push-the-words rule, which is correct and should not change). Mark the sorted-first member data-stack="lead" and the rest data-stack="follow", leaving every node exactly where it is in the DOM. In b.css, `.b-item[data-stack="follow"] .b-away, .b-item[data-stack="follow"] .b-tick { visibility: hidden }` - visibility, never display or removal, so nothing reflows, audit.mjs skips them (it already excludes visibility:hidden), and every gate query still finds the node and reads its textContent. Set the follower's --push flush rather than gapped (previous member's cumulative copy height + 1px, dropping the 10px inter-row space) and give it `border-top: 1px solid var(--fore-16); padding-top: 12px`, with the lead getting `padding-bottom: 12px`, so one hairline separates the two rows. Paint one plate for the run from the lead only: write a --stack-h custom property in place() (sum of member copy heights plus hairlines) and use it on a `.b-item[data-stack="lead"] .b-copy::before` inset plate; suppress the existing `[data-crowded="true"]` box-shadow plate on stack members so the invisible var(--back) plate stops double-printing, and suppress the lead's plate fill (keeping the hairlines) while it is data-editing so it does not stack with the fore-06 editing plate. For the spoken form, do not add role="group" - that needs a wrapper, i.e. reparenting. Extend the existing .b-vh spans instead: lead ' days away, first of 2 moments on this day,' and follower ' days away, 2nd of 2 moments on this day,'. That keeps one listitem per moment, keeps 'days away' in every row's textContent so the unit assertion still passes, keeps each row's own .b-grab name intact, and states the count once per row without inventing structure. Every top stays away x scale, so the proportionality assertion is untouched.
